title: How many fold lines and turns does this building outline have?
description: The outer boundary of the new Parliament Building in Delhi has three long sides and three short sides, taking turns. Folding it and turning it about its centre shows its lines and its angles of symmetry. The video also tries a fold from corner to corner, which fails because a long side lands on a short side.
teaching_notes: One idea: only fold lines that make the halves match count, so a corner to corner fold fails when the sides are unequal. Watch for students who give one line of symmetry for each side.

source: Figure it Out Q7 (section 9.2, second block)
video_script.why: The child must find the lines of symmetry and the angles of symmetry of a shape whose sides are long and short in turn, and see that the sides decide which folds work.
video_script.substitution: Imagine the outline cut from paper, then fold it and turn it about its centre to see what matches.
video_script.anchor: the outer boundary of the new Parliament Building in Delhi, drawn as an outline with three long sides and three short sides in turn
video_script.payoff_line: The outline has three lines of symmetry and three angles of symmetry

final_answer.value: a) yes, 3 lines of symmetry; b) yes, 120°, 240°, 360°
final_answer.spoken: yes, there are three lines of symmetry, and the angles of symmetry are one hundred twenty, two hundred forty and three hundred sixty degrees

never_show: six fold lines drawn through opposite corners as if they worked
maths_rules: the outline has 6 sides: 3 long sides alternate with 3 short sides
a line through the middle of a long side and the middle of the opposite short side is a line of symmetry; 3 long sides give 3 such lines
a line from one corner to the opposite corner puts a long side on a short side, so it is not a line of symmetry
turn: the outline fits after 1/3 of a full turn, 360 / 3 = 120, so 120, 240 and 360 degrees fit
check: a half turn of 180 degrees puts a long side on a short side, so it does not fit
slip: 6 sides do not give 6 lines; only 3 lines work
video_script.design: One idea: sides that differ in length decide which folds work. One outline all video, long sides in teal and short sides in amber.

<bookmark mark='angle'/>A turn about the centre that makes the outline look the same is called an angle of symmetry.
